page.content:
San Francisco nonprofit that hosts Wikipedia and sister projects.

How Wikimedia Foundation connects

  • Topic: Wikipedia — The Wikimedia Foundation hosts and fundraises for Wikipedia.
  • Character: Jimmy Wales — Wales helped establish the Wikimedia Foundation in 2003.
  • Work: Wikimedia Commons — Commons is a Wikimedia Foundation sister project.
  • Work: Wikidata — Wikidata is a Wikimedia Foundation sister project.

What is Wikimedia Foundation?

The Wikimedia Foundation (2003) holds the servers, trademarks, and fundraising for Wikipedia, Commons, Wikidata, and the other Wikimedia projects.

Key threads lead to Wikipedia, Jimmy Wales, Wikimedia Commons and Wikidata.
